title: VendPoint Start-Up Returns: Trial Length Questions
content:
Questions on how long an item has been on trial in a VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machine when unused units of the item most recently added to that machine are returned during its start-up months.

**What decides the trial share?** The trial share follows the calendar days from the date of the item's add entry to today: at least the long trial days give the long-trial share, at least the mid trial days but fewer than the long ones give the mid-trial share, and fewer give a share of one.

**What are the figures?** The long trial days are 60 and the long-trial share is 0.95; the mid trial days are 30 and the mid-trial share is 0.97.

**Which add entry?** The add entry of the item most recently added, the one carrying the highest planogram request reference on the machine's selection history.

**Do days count from the first vend?** No; they count from the date of the item's add entry to today, in calendar days.

| Calendar days since the add entry | Trial share |
|---|---|
| 0 to 29 | 1 |
| 30 | 0.97 |
| 59 | 0.97 |
| 60 or more | 0.95 |

Hypothetical: an add entry dated 1 March gives 30 days on 31 March (share 0.97) and 29 days on 30 March (share 1).
